mapper.select: select sif.inventory_flow_id, sif.shop_id, sif.put_storage_id, sif.out_storage_id, sif.type, sif.type_details, sif.start_time, sif.end_time, sif.operator_id, sif.operator_name, sif.operator_time, sif.create_time, sif.inventory_flow_num, sif.notes from storage_inventory_flow sif where sif.shop_id = #{param.shopId} and sif.inventory_flow_id = #{param.inventoryFlowId}

select sif.inventory_flow_id, sif.shop_id, sif.put_storage_id, sif.out_storage_id, sif.type, sif.type_details, sif.start_time, sif.end_time, sif.operator_id, sif.operator_name, sif.operator_time, sif.create_time, sif.inventory_flow_num, sif.notes, sifg.goods_id, sifg.goods_num, sifg.buy_num, mgb.goods_name, mgb.goods_spec from storage_inventory_flow_goods sifg left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base mgb on sifg.goods_id = mgb.goods_id left join storage_inventory_flow sif on sifg.inventory_flow_id = sif.inventory_flow_id where sif.shop_id = #{param.shopId} and sif.type = #{param.type}
limit #{param.page}, #{param.limit}
